sourceQuote: It aims to cultivate comprehensive engineering technical talents with a solid theoretical foundation in engineering thermophysics, the ability to design energy power systems, and innovative thinking.
targetQuote: 培养目标旨在培养具有扎实的工程热物理理论基础、动力系统设计能力和创新思维的综合工程技术人才They能够在能源动力、热工、制冷与空调、新能源等领域从事科学研究、技术开发、工程设计和运行管理。
